national_sources.name: the Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics (DGBAS)
the Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan)

notes.inflation: Taiwan's statistics office does not offer its data to automated downloads, so inflation here is the annual average change in consumer prices from the IMF World Economic Outlook, actual years only; there is no monthly inflation figure on this page. The interest rate is the Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan)'s discount rate, the rate on its rediscounts, taken from the bank's own open-data file and shown as the rate in force at the end of each month.
notes.labour: Unemployment is the annual rate from the IMF World Economic Outlook, actual years only. Monthly labour force figures are published by Taiwan's statistics office but are not available to automated downloads, so they are not shown.
notes.trade: Goods trade is Taiwan's monthly customs data as the IMF republishes it, in US dollars, converted to New Taiwan dollars at each month's average of the Federal Reserve's daily exchange rate. Exports are valued free on board, imports including cost, insurance and freight. The current account and foreign direct investment are not shown: the free international sources this site uses do not cover Taiwan.
notes.public: Debt and the budget balance are the IMF World Economic Outlook's general government figures, actual years only, so estimates and projections never appear as data.
notes.markets: The exchange rate is the Federal Reserve's daily rate, averaged by month. There is no 10-year government bond yield or business confidence index: no free series covers Taiwan.
